versions_differ: Different versions of AIODOS: update both machines.
set_aside: “{name}” no longer entrusts anything to you: {reason}. This can be undone in its Network view.
ollama_down: Ollama isn't answering on “{name}”: the embedding model can't be checked there, so nothing is entrusted.
outdated: “{name}” has web pages to read, which it only entrusts to an up-to-date machine (reading limited to the public Internet): update AIODOS on this machine.
too_long: On “{name}”: computation too long (at most {minutes} min on a friend's machine).
not_yours: This unit is no longer entrusted to you.
file_stays: This file stays on its owner's machine: the order was sent without it.
file_gone: This unit's file is no longer there.
chunk_outside: The requested chunk is outside the file.
input_not_yours: This input does not belong to the unit entrusted to you.
input_gone: This input is no longer there.
taken_back: Unit taken back or cancelled in the meantime.
done_elsewhere: Unit already done by another machine: this result is no longer needed, and nothing is held against you.
check_impossible: The owner can't check it for now: unit put back in the queue.
sample_mismatch: a result doesn't match the computation redone here ({error})
sample_failed: Result refused: the spot check failed, nothing more will be entrusted to you.
result_not_saved: Result from “{name}” couldn't be saved here ({kind})
result_not_saved_owner: The owner couldn't save the result: unit put back in the queue.
failures_aside: {count} units returned as failed in a row, without a single result
nobody_can: None of my machines can compute it. {message}
